sections.title: New York Predictive Analytics Technology Stack
sections.description: ClickMasters deploys production predictive analytics on the platforms New York's enterprise organizations use.

items.title: Modeling Frameworks
items.description: XGBoost and LightGBM for structured tabular prediction (fraud, churn, credit); PyTorch for deep learning; Prophet and TFT for time-series forecasting; scikit-learn for baseline and feature selection pipelines.
items.label: Modeling

items.title: Explainability
items.description: SHAP for individual-prediction explanations — required for FCRA adverse action reason codes in New York consumer credit applications, and for SR 26-2 model validation documentation.
items.label: Explainability

items.title: MLOps
items.description: MLflow for experiment tracking and model registry; SageMaker Pipelines or Azure ML Pipelines for automated retraining; Evidently AI for drift monitoring with PagerDuty alerting.
items.label: MLOps

items.title: Integration & Data Infrastructure
items.description: Salesforce API for CRM-integrated lead scoring and churn alerts; Epic FHIR API for healthcare risk stratification; REST API endpoints via FastAPI for operational system integration. Snowflake and Databricks for feature engineering pipelines.
items.label: Integration

sections.title: Why Most New York Analytics Projects Fail
sections.description: IDC data shows that 75% of enterprise analytics projects never reach production deployment. ClickMasters addresses the most common failure modes.

items.title: Prediction Silos
items.description: Models that live in Jupyter notebooks or standalone dashboards that require decision-makers to change their workflow to access. ClickMasters integrates predictions into Salesforce, operational dashboards, and workflow tools where decisions are already made.
items.label: Silos

items.title: No Monitoring
items.description: Production models without drift detection degrade silently — often for months before the accuracy problem becomes visible in business metrics. ClickMasters deploys monitoring with distribution-level drift alerts as standard.
items.label: Monitoring

items.title: Missing Business Metric Translation
items.description: Technical accuracy metrics (AUC-ROC, RMSE) that never get translated into business impact ($saved, $earned, risk avoided). ClickMasters measures the business metric from day one.
items.label: Business metrics

items.title: Threshold Not Optimized
items.description: Default 50% probability threshold used for all classification models regardless of the cost ratio between false positives and false negatives specific to that business context. ClickMasters calibrates thresholds to your specific economics.
items.label: Threshold
